note: 4x3090 host, shared with other users. Which GPUs are safe changes run to run (e.g. 2026-07-23: GPU0 and GPU3 were held by other users' active compute -- not ours to touch even though _probe_max_memory would find a few GiB 'free' on GPU0). cuda_visible_devices is NOT read from this file -- 00_config.py's _safe_gpu_indices() checks nvidia-smi + ps ownership at the start of every run and hard-excludes any GPU with a process owned by someone other than the current user. max_memory below applies only to whatever subset survives that check.
